Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault is heading to Nintendo Switch 2 on September 2, 2026! Play the free demo and pre-order today: https://ninten.do/6002aGaGE

Would you rather be a fearless adventurer or crafty merchant? How about both? In this action-RPG with roguelike elements, loot dungeons and sell the things you find back at your shop. Invest in the village around you to unlock new weapons, armor, shop decorations, and—more importantly—restore hope that things can one day turn around.
